name: Naraku Reijou ~Koukaku Saserareta Onna Gunjin no Tenraku Geki~
original_name: 奈落隷将～降格させられた女軍人の転落劇～
source:
The game features two rather high-ranked women who are demoted in a reorganization of the military and, just like the trio of the previous game, have to face the less than appealing prospect of being turned into comfort women...

[edited from a comment by DarkSpooky]
translation:
游戏的主角是两名相当高级的女性，她们在军队重组中被降级，就像前一款游戏中的三人组一样，必须面对变成慰安妇的不太吸引人的前景……

[根据DarkSpooky的评论编辑]
